coverage: Partial broad production identities; only selected documented EU versions, not complete Czech tables.
gaps: Most older European Carisma, Lancer, Galant, Pajero, Colt and Space Wagon engine/gearbox combinations remain unsourced in this checkpoint.
Minica/eK/Minicab and regional generation histories remain grouped; no claim of complete global history.
Colt hybrid gearbox 2 electric/4 thermal ratios are not added together; gears null.
ASX rounded prose dimensions differ from precise millimetre drawing; use 4239/1797/1575/2639 from drawing.
Model A first serial-production year unresolved between 1917 project and November1918 first completed car.

All tables PARTIAL. Only 7 generation records have selected technical rows: modern Colt, original/rebadged ASX, third Outlander, original Eclipse Cross, modern Space Star and L200 V. Earlier Colt/Lancer/Galant/Carisma, Pajero, Space Wagon and most historical/global regional records need substantial follow-up.
2017 Bulgarian brochure text extraction loses Cyrillic headings; engine output and labelled 0–100 and dimension drawing used, consumption-cycle/mass labels not safely read so left null.

Outlander 2020 brochure used for exact ICE99kW/211Nm and weightedWLTP2.0/45km; system165kW is only in scope note. Luxembourg pricelist164kW system is not combined with ICE values or treated as equivalent.
Some generations lack bodies because family-wide assumptions were avoided. No complete list of all facelifts or gearboxes claimed.

Photo search bounded, not exhausted. 3000GT candidates were cropped or lacked an identifiable author; ModelA candidates cropped/obstructed, 500/Colt600 museum views have barriers/obstructions and were rejected. OutlanderIII lacked a suitable whole-car file in root categories; subcategory search remains needed.
Colt 2009 OEM UK brochure mirror returnedHTTP403; no technical figures were imported from snippets.
Mizushima/Leo three-wheel commercial vehicles, Mitsubishi360 van and some regional Delica/Minicab generations remain further historical work.

Some current European PHEV/EV and older CZ programme remain absent: EclipseCross PHEV, OutlanderIV PHEV, historical Sapporo coupe/modernised regional Lancer/Delica variants need a separate source audit. All 105 generation records are partial; 98 have no version table.
excluded: PX33 military prototype, race-only models/concepts, motorcycles and heavy trucks.
Colt Galant/Lancer/GTO aliases not duplicated as new cars; Chariot/Chariot Grandis retained under Space Wagon.
Unverified future 2026 revived Pajero/ASX VR-e/Eclipse Sportback not treated as confirmed production.
